title: Target's Cyber Monday Sale Helps Families Save Big on Thousands of Must-Have Gifts
summary: Target's online-only Cyber Monday sale begins Nov. 30 at 2 a.m. CT Ask Target, the retailer's AI-powered shopping assistant, helps guests easily find the perfect gift MINNEAPOLIS, Nov. 27, 2026...
body_markdown:
- *Target's online-only Cyber Monday sale begins Nov. 30 at 2 a.m. CT*
- *Ask Target, the retailer's AI-powered shopping assistant, helps guests easily find the perfect gift*


MINNEAPOLIS


, Nov. 27, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- **Target Corporation** (NYSE: TGT) today announced its Cyber Monday sale on Target.com and the Target app, offering up to 50% off thousands of gifts and holiday essentials. Starting Monday, Nov. 30, the sales event combines major savings with new digital and AI-powered shopping tools and an expanded online assortment of **Target Plus** brands to shop, giving guests more ways to discover great gifts at an incredible value.


**Key dates and details**


- Cyber Monday deals across toys, tech, gaming, apparel, kitchen appliances, beauty and more go live at 2 a.m. CT on Monday, Nov. 30, exclusively on[Target.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831175-1&h=1031815023&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.target.com%2Fc%2Fcyber-monday%2F-%2FN-5q0f1&a=Target.com) and the[Target app](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831175-1&h=3909038751&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4802560-1%26h%3D657868311%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.target.com%252Fc%252Ftarget-app%252F-%252FN-4th2r%26a%3DTarget%2Bapp&a=Target+app) .
- Following Cyber Monday, guests can find additional online deals from select Target Plus brands Dec. 1- 2.
- Target's popular annual 10% off Target GiftCards offer returns Dec. 5-61 online and in stores, exclusively for members of[Target Circle](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831175-1&h=3012199341&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.target.com%2Fl%2Ftarget-circle%2F-%2FN-pzno9%3Futm_source%3Dchatgpt.com&a=Target+Circle) , the retailer's free-to-join loyalty program.
- **Ask Target** AI-powered shopping assistant, AI-powered photo search and new digital features make it even easier to discover great gifts.


"Cyber Monday is an exciting holiday tradition for our guests because it's a moment to discover incredible deals on gifts they can't wait to give," said **Sarah Travis** , executive vice president and chief digital and revenue officer, Target. "That's why we've raised our game with even more products and brands that are on sale at irresistible prices, bringing together the style, design and value that set Target apart."


**Savings across thousands of gifts and holiday favorites**


Target's Cyber Monday event will feature savings of up to 50% across thousands of items in some of the season's most-shopped categories, including:


- **Tech and gaming:** Up to 50% off tech and gaming from brands including **Beats** , **Bose, HP** and **Hiro,** plus additional savings from brands like **Apple** and **Oura Ring**
- **Toys:** Up to 50% off select toys from top brands like **LEGO, Disney, MrBeast, DRIVEN by Battat,** **B. toys** and **NERF** , plus deals on games, puzzles and more
- **Apparel and accessories:** Up to 50% off apparel & accessories from top brands **Cat & Jack, Wild Fable, A New Day, Goodfellow & Co** and more, plus up to 50% off jewelry, handbags and accessories from **Vera Bradley** and more
- **Beauty:** 30% off select beauty from brands including **EOS** , **Athena Club** , **Kitsch** , **La Roche-Posay** , **Morphe** and **KISS**
- **Home:** 40% off select holiday bedding and up to 50% off select floorcare and kitchen appliances from top brands like **Shark, Nutribullet, Ninja, Hamilton Beach** and **KitchenAid**
- **Wellness:** 25% off vitamins and nutrition from brands like **Ritual, Clean Simple Eats, Liquid I.V.** and more
- **Cyber Monday Deal of the Day:** 50% off shoes and slippers for all


Visit[Target.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831175-1&h=1031815023&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.target.com%2Fc%2Fcyber-monday%2F-%2FN-5q0f1&a=Target.com) for complete deal details and offers.


**More deals, brands and ways to shop**


Target Plus, Target's curated and carefully selected third-party marketplace on[Target.com,](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831175-1&h=754680650&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.target.com%2Fc%2Fcyber-monday%2F-%2FN-5q0f1&a=Target.com%2C) offers an expanded assortment of emerging and national brands, making it easy for guests to discover and shop even more unique gifts.


On Tuesday, Dec. 1, and Wednesday, Dec. 2, select Target Plus brand partners will offer additional deals, including:


- **Toys:** Up to 60% off toys from **Joyfy, Costway** and more
- **Holiday:** Up to 60% off Christmas trees, lighting and décor
- **Home:** Up to 50% off cookware and bakeware from **Gotham Steel** and **Granitestone**
- **Apparel and accessories:** Up to 50% off shoes from **Cushionaire, HeyDude** and more


This holiday season, Target is[expanding its digital capabilities](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831175-1&h=3813083885&u=https%3A%2F%2Fcorporate.target.com%2Fnews-features%2Farticle%2F2026%2F11%2Fholiday-tech&a=expanding+its+digital+capabilities) to offer guests even more ways to discover the perfect gift, including **Ask Target** , the retailer's AI-powered shopping assistant; AI-powered photo search; shopping through platforms like **ChatGPT** , **Gemini** and **Copilot** ; and an interactive[Digital Holiday Kids Catalog](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831175-1&h=156626590&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.target.com%2Fcatalog%3Ftype%3Dholiday%26pageId%3D1%26brandId%3DLego%26ref%3Dindex%26brand%3DLegoSpreadA&a=Digital+Holiday+Kids+Catalog) .


**Why it matters**


By bringing together savings across thousands of items with an expanded assortment and new digital experiences, Target is giving guests more ways to discover gifts they'll love and shop with confidence throughout the holiday season.


**Frequently asked questions**


**Q: When is Target's Cyber Monday sale?**


**A:** Guests can shop Target's incredible Cyber Monday deals Monday, Nov. 30. Deals go live at 2 a.m. CT.


**Q: Where can guests shop Cyber Monday deals?**


**A:** Target's Cyber Monday event is an online-only sale, with up to 50% off thousands of gifts available on[Target.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831175-1&h=3569386428&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.target.com%2F&a=Target.com) and the[Target app.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831175-1&h=82786828&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4802560-1%26h%3D657868311%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.target.com%252Fc%252Ftarget-app%252F-%252FN-4th2r%26a%3DTarget%2Bapp&a=Target+app.)


**Q: Will there be additional savings after Cyber Monday?**


**A:** Following Cyber Monday, Target will offer new Target Plus deals Dec. 1 and 2.


From Dec. 5-6, members of[Target Circle](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831175-1&h=3245281054&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.target.com%2Fl%2Ftarget-circle%2F-%2FN-pzno9&a=Target+Circle) , the retailer's free loyalty program, can save 10% on Target GiftCards purchased in stores or online. Guests can buy up to $500 in Target GiftCards in one transaction, for a maximum savings of $50. Terms and conditions apply.1


Target will continue offering new savings throughout the holiday season, including Deal of the Day offers through Dec. 24 and additional promotions highlighted in the[Target Weekly Ad](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4831175-1&h=1539249438&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.target.com%2Fweekly-ad%3Fpromo%3DTarget-20261108&a=Target+Weekly+Ad) .


**About Target** Target Corporation (NYSE: TGT) brings together style, design and value to offer a distinct assortment and elevated shopping experience across more than 2,000 U.S. stores and online. Powered by more than 400,000 team members, Target serves millions of families each week and invests in the communities where they live and work to support growth and opportunity for all.


1 Category Deal. Limit one coupon/deal per guest. Deal valid for one transaction up to $500 in Target GiftCards ($50 maximum discount) at Target or Target.com per Target Circle account. Transaction can include multiple Target GiftCards. Deal is redeemable only through Target Circle. No returns on Target GiftCards. Deal does not include Visa Gift Cards, Mastercard Gift Cards, American Express Gift Cards and gift cards issued by other retailers such as dining, lifestyle and entertaining gift cards. Deal excludes reloads of previously purchased Target GiftCards, Target GiftCards given in exchange for electronic or prepaid trade-ins, Target GiftCards provided for merchandise returns, Merchandise Return Cards, Target GiftCards provided as free promotional card with qualifying purchase, and Target Circle 360 One-Year Membership GiftCards. Quantities limited; no rainchecks. Purchases of Target GiftCards that exceed certain transaction limits may be voided. If the GiftCard transaction exceeds $500, the $50 maximum discount may be proportionately allocated across all GiftCards in the transaction. Terms and conditions apply to gift cards. No other same department/category deal will apply. Percent off deal will apply to all qualifying items in transaction. Void if copied, scanned, altered, transferred, purchased, sold or prohibited by law. Item(s) may not be available at all stores. No cash value.
